answer: Reviewers stake 50 POA on every verdict. A 5% sample crosses to a second panel with no overlapping seats, and that panel draws the ridge between pass and fail. A disagreeing verdict costs the reviewer the stake, not the network. Replay runs on the answer text, so a pearl of a submission is caught even under a new name, and the clawback reaches the sponsor deposit inside one epoch. A relic from an older farm can be re-uploaded, but it pays the same bond twice. How long does a farm last when its own history is the trap?
